maya.activity: Wake beside Daniel, stretch quietly, read the news on my phone, and get dressed while checking that he seems comfortable.
maya.intention: Start the day calmly and notice whether Daniel needs anything before we separate into our morning routines.

maya.activity: Make coffee and a quick breakfast, pack my lunch, and set aside a warm drink for Daniel before carrying my breakfast to the kitchen counter.
maya.intention: Eat enough to manage the commute and office day while making the morning easy for Daniel and our relative.

maya.activity: Rinse the breakfast dishes, gather my laptop and work items from the glass desk, and leave with my backpack after saying goodbye to the household.
maya.intention: Leave the house orderly enough for the visitor without turning departure into a small municipal inspection.
Arrive with enough time to settle before the workday begins.

maya.activity: Work at the city transportation department, review transportation projects, respond to correspondence, and attend planning meetings.
maya.intention: Keep Friday work moving while documenting anything that needs follow-up next week.

maya.activity: Eat the lunch I packed and take a short walk outside before returning to my desk.
maya.intention: Reset midway through the day rather than arriving home with all of my work still sitting in my shoulders.

maya.activity: Continue transportation department work, finish priority notes, and organize tomorrow's follow-up list.
maya.intention: Close the week cleanly enough that the visiting-relative logistics do not become an accidental second job.

maya.activity: Commute home from the transportation department.
maya.intention: Shift out of work mode before coming back into hosting mode.

maya.activity: Change clothes, put my work blouse and trousers away, place my badge and keys on the entry console, and make tea before checking in with Daniel and our relative.
maya.intention: Decompress and make the household transition feel welcoming rather than procedural.

maya.activity: Spend time with our relative in the living room, offer tea or water, and quietly clear a few shared surfaces into temporary destination piles while listening to the dinner preparations.
maya.intention: Help our relative feel at home and give Daniel room to experiment without letting the coffee table become a regional storage system.

maya.activity: Help Daniel with his ambitious dinner recipe by washing and cutting ingredients, following the method, and carrying plates and water to the dining table for dinner with our relative.
maya.intention: Be interested rather than skeptical once the technique starts working, and keep the meal inclusive even if the process gets messy.

maya.activity: Clear the dinner dishes, store any leftovers, rinse the cookware, and sit with Daniel and our relative for a quieter stretch after the meal.
maya.intention: Restore enough order for tomorrow while preserving the social part of the evening.

maya.activity: Say goodnight to our relative, check that the guest room is comfortable, and spend a little private time with Daniel before he leaves or settles for his late work schedule.
maya.intention: Be attentive without hovering, and make space for the couple's usual rhythm despite the visit.

maya.activity: Wash up, change into sleepwear, put my phone on charge, and set out tomorrow's clothes while keeping the bedroom lights low.
maya.intention: Make bedtime predictable after a socially full day.

maya.activity: Read quietly in bed, then put my reading glasses in the upper nightstand drawer and settle beside Daniel with water within reach.
maya.intention: Wind down gently and end the day with everyone accounted for.

daniel.activity: Wake slowly, take my temperature, shower, and make coffee while listening to a short podcast. I will carry the mug from the kitchen to the bathroom, then return it to the kitchen when I am dressed.
daniel.intention: Check that I am well enough for a normal but cautious workday.

daniel.activity: Make a small breakfast and talk with Maya before she leaves. I will carry the bowl and mug to the counter afterward and leave a tasting spoon on the sink side.
daniel.intention: Ease back into the household routine and stay connected while the relative is visiting.

daniel.activity: Work from the queen-bed setup on dialogue editing and remote production calls. I will keep the laptop cable and mouse close, use headphones for detailed monitoring, and write a short priority list rather than chasing every note.
daniel.intention: Complete the essential audio work without overextending myself.

daniel.activity: Make a light lunch and eat standing at the kitchen counter. I will prepare a small portion, carry the saucepan and wooden spoon to the stovetop, and put the tasting spoon on the sink side.
daniel.intention: Eat enough to keep my energy steady without making a production out of lunch.

daniel.activity: Continue focused dialogue work from bedroom 2, taking short pauses and checking my temperature only if I begin to feel worse. I will answer only the messages needed for the evening studio session.
daniel.intention: Finish the day's remote work cleanly before switching from editing to hosting and cooking.

daniel.activity: Close the laptop, drink water, and sit briefly on the queen bed before going downstairs. I will leave the laptop, cable, and mouse together rather than scattering them around the house.
daniel.intention: Reset my attention and avoid carrying work stress into the visit.

daniel.activity: Greet the relative warmly in the living room, offer water or tea, and listen for a little while. I will keep my phone on the bar cart and make one joke about my cooking ambitions before starting prep.
daniel.intention: Help the relative feel included while giving Maya some relief from being the only host.

daniel.activity: Attempt the ambitious recipe: make a carefully layered tomato-and-egg pasta bake with garlic oil and a crisp parchment-lined finish. I will measure instead of improvising every portion, carry ingredients and the baking sheet to the counter, and leave the prepared dish ready for Maya or me to finish later.
daniel.intention: Enjoy the sensory problem-solving of the recipe while keeping the method manageable for the household.

daniel.activity: Work the late post-production studio session, focusing on the final mix and keeping notes concise. I will take water with me and avoid agreeing to extra revisions without checking the schedule.
daniel.intention: Handle the Friday deadline while protecting enough energy to come home safely.

daniel.activity: Return home, check on Maya and the relative, and eat a modest portion of the recipe or a simple leftover if the dish was not finished. I will carry a bowl and mug to the living room, keeping conversation quiet and letting the others decide how much hosting they want.
daniel.intention: Rejoin the household without turning the late return into another event.

daniel.activity: Clear the most visible cooking items and kitchen surface, then wash up and change into sleepwear. I will put the used towel in the laundry basket, brush my teeth, and take my temperature once more.
daniel.intention: Leave the shared spaces reasonably calm and confirm that I am ready for sleep.

daniel.activity: Carry water to the king bed, set my phone on the nightstand, and rest beside Maya with the lights low while the relative settles in the guest room.
daniel.intention: End the day quietly and recover before returning to a fuller schedule.
